verdicts.reason: A shrinks the 'Longest Day Sale' banner to an illegible tag, drops the product below the copy so the original order (brand, banner, product, headline) is reversed, sets the legal fine print almost as large as the subhead, and pushes the CTA nearly full-width against the bottom edge. B keeps the original sequence and the banner reads clearly, but the logo sits small and off-centre in the top-right, the banner runs to the canvas edges, the legal line is still too prominent, and the headline breaks with an orphaned 'last'.
